title: Put each console in its own systemd scope so the OOM killer does not take down the whole window
notes: Chosen gated launcher and Linux-only user-manager D-Bus. All three medium challenges addressed: minimal private IPC, asynchronous app startup, and 500 ms final-result observation. One coherent PR preferred. Study completed at build pre-flight (why=study). No implementation or runtime validation; suitable Rust/systemd host needed for build validation.

defaults_used.default: Parent-controlled gated helper; CLI alternative rejected for exactly-once fallback and status semantics
